name: strict live market-friction capture seam
implementation: Added a fail-closed MarketFrictionCapture recorder for genuine venue transport observations.
Capture identity requires explicit PRODUCTION or SANDBOX environment and LIVE_CAPTURE transport.
Each observation is validated through the canonical historical market-friction evidence normalizer before entering the capture.
Strictly increasing timestamps are enforced at ingestion and finalization preserves the exact evidence fingerprint.
Capture manifest binds venue, environment, symbol, endpoint, capture ID, time range, sample count, and evidence SHA-256.
No network client was added and no fixture/replay can be promoted to REAL through this seam.
evidence_boundary: The environment still has no successful Delta network capture available.
The Delta adapter currently exposes a public L2 snapshot endpoint, not a historical L2 endpoint.
This phase therefore implements the acquisition/recording seam but does not claim historical venue evidence.
Realized fills remain unavailable unless an authenticated or otherwise authoritative venue fill source is captured and independently bound.
next: Execute the live capture seam in a network-enabled, authorized Delta environment; bind genuine observations to the exact OOS interval and venue product, then certify economics only if all required evidence gates pass.
